description: This Java source file defines the JpaRuleNodeDao class, which implements data access operations for RuleNode entities in a SQL database, including methods for querying, deleting, and retrieving rule nodes by various criteria within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: JpaRuleNodeDao
classes.description: Data access object class for RuleNode entities, providing methods to query, delete, and manage rule nodes in the database.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO, which is RuleNodeEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides the JpaRepository instance used for database operations on RuleNodeEntity.

methods.name: findRuleNodesByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds rule nodes by tenant ID and type, with optional configuration search.

methods.name: findAllRuleNodesByType
methods.description: Retrieves all rule nodes of a specific type with pagination.

methods.name: findAllRuleNodesByTypeAndVersionLessThan
methods.description: Retrieves rule nodes of a specific type with version less than the specified value, with pagination.

methods.name: findAllRuleNodeIdsByTypeAndVersionLessThan
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of rule nodes of a specific type with version less than the specified value, with pagination.

methods.name: findAllRuleNodeByIds
methods.description: Finds rule nodes by a list of rule node IDs.

methods.name: findByExternalIds
methods.description: Finds rule nodes associated with a specific rule chain ID and external IDs.

methods.name: deleteByIdIn
methods.description: Deletes rule nodes by a list of rule node IDs.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is RULE_NODE.
